records.original_stem:
Case A: An ISO 5 viable air result is 2 CFU per cubic meter per media device. Staff compare it with the described action level of greater than 1 CFU.

Case B: A separate ISO 5 surface result is exactly 3 CFU per media device, and staff compare it with the described surface threshold of greater than 3 CFU.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Air and surface results require their respective sampling units and thresholds.
A.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. Air는 m³와 media device, surface는 media device 기준을 확인한다.

B.original_option_text: Exactly 3 CFU does not exceed a threshold written as greater than 3, although other relevant findings still require assessment.
B.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. >와 ≥를 바꾸지 않는다. Threshold 미초과를 모든 품질 문제 없음의 보증으로 확대하지 않는다.

C.original_option_text: An action-level result can be dismissed solely because the preparation looks clear.
C.original_rationale_ko:
오류를 고르는 문항의 정답. 제품 외관은 환경모니터링 action level의 대응을 대체하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: An action-level result is assessed within the applicable investigation and reporting framework.

D.original_option_text: The first result exceeds the stated ISO 5 viable-air action threshold.
D.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. ISO 5 air >1과 surface >3은 다른 기준이다.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A laboratory reports viable-air counts per cubic meter, but staff treat that unit as one liter when comparing it with the policy's air limits.

Case B: A pass-through connects two different ISO-classified spaces, and personnel apply the less clean space's threshold without considering the stated policy rule.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Counts from all sites and media should be pooled before applying a per-device action threshold.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Site·media device별 기준을 옛 cumulative 방식으로 임의 합산하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: Results from distinct sites or media devices should not be combined into an invented cumulative comparison.

B.original_option_text: The pass-through necessarily uses the less clean connected space's classification.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 연결된 공간 중 더 깨끗한 ISO 분류를 사용하는 policy 조건을 확인한다.
교정된 설명: The described pass-through rule uses the cleaner connected space's ISO classification.

C.original_option_text: The same numeric CFU threshold applies to every ISO class and measurement type.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. ISO5·7·8 및 측정 방식별 숫자·단위가 다르다.
교정된 설명: The appropriate threshold depends on ISO class and whether the measurement is nonviable, viable air, or surface.

D.original_option_text: One cubic meter corresponds to 1,000 liters, so the reported denominator must not be treated as one liter.
D.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 수치뿐 아니라 실제 공기량·분모를 보존한다.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A pharmacy receives a microbiology report showing an action-level result, but personnel plan to delay Board notification until final organism identification is complete.

Case B: The same ISO area has another action-level finding within 60 days, separated from the first by an acceptable result.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Any employee may replace the specified reporting role without checking the policy.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 해당 보고 담당자의 범위와 책임을 확인한다.
교정된 설명: MOR, designated PIC, or the specified pharmacist designee follows the applicable reporting role.

B.original_option_text: An acceptable result between two findings necessarily prevents the described repeat-within-60-days trigger.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 같은 ISO area의 반복 action level은 반드시 연속 결과여야 하는 것이 아니다.
교정된 설명: The intervening acceptable result does not remove the described repeat-within-60-days microbiologist-engagement trigger.

C.original_option_text: The described one-business-day notification clock runs from microbiology-report receipt without waiting for later identification.
C.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 최초 알려진 action-level result와 나중 organism identification을 구분한다.

D.original_option_text: Once notification is sent, organism and location trends are no longer relevant.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 외부 통지와 microbiological investigation·trend analysis는 다른 작업이다.
교정된 설명: Organism identification, location history, and trends remain relevant to investigation.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A pharmacy exceeds a nonviable-particle action level and proposes using a conditional viable-remediation pathway to avoid stopping and recertifying, with no different Board direction.

Case B: A pharmacy considering permitted conditional work during viable remediation assumes an additional remediation BUD ceiling can extend the shorter baseline limit for its actual CSP category.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: The remediation ceiling replaces any shorter category or chemical-stability limit.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 추가 ceiling은 최대 허용조건을 더 제한하며 기존 짧은 BUD를 늘리지 않는다.
교정된 설명: An additional remediation ceiling does not extend a shorter otherwise-applicable category or stability limit.

B.original_option_text: The described nonviable pathway requires stopping, full remediation, and recertification as applicable rather than importing the viable exception.
B.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Nonviable failure의 중단·완전 remediation·recertification과 viable의 한정 경로를 구분한다.

C.original_option_text: A finding in one PEC proves every other PEC can continue without assessment.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Affected·unaffected 구분과 조사 결과에 근거한 제한적 판단을 유지한다.
교정된 설명: An affected PEC and an appropriately assessed unaffected PEC can require different operational decisions.

D.original_option_text: Describing the work as clinically useful alone establishes all conditions for viable-remediation continuation.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 필요성만으로 자동 재개하지 않고 공간·공정·위험평가·mitigation 조건을 확인한다.
교정된 설명: Conditional viable-remediation work requires the specified risk assessment, implemented remediation, repeat sampling, and product-risk controls.

proposed_unapplied_remediation.scenario: A Massachusetts Board-licensed sterile compounding pharmacy receives an action-level viable surface result in one of two ISO 5 primary engineering controls. Staff initiate remediation and assess the second PEC as unaffected using a documented risk assessment. Later, a separate nonviable-particle action-level result occurs. The Board has issued no different direction.
proposed_unapplied_remediation.lead_in: Which statements correctly apply to these events? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Continuation in the unaffected PEC during viable remediation depends on the policy conditions and the risk assessment.
The separate nonviable-particle failure automatically qualifies for the same viable-remediation continuation pathway.
A remediation BUD ceiling does not extend a shorter otherwise applicable limit for a preparation.
The affected ISO 5 PEC may resume ordinary compounding solely because another PEC has acceptable results.

records.original_stem:
Case A: A pharmacy exceeds a nonviable-particle action level and proposes using a conditional viable-remediation pathway to avoid stopping and recertifying, with no different Board direction.

Case B: A pharmacy considering permitted conditional work during viable remediation assumes an additional remediation BUD ceiling can extend the shorter baseline limit for its actual CSP category.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: The described nonviable pathway requires stopping, full remediation, and recertification as applicable rather than importing the viable exception.
A.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. Nonviable failure의 중단·완전 remediation·recertification과 viable의 한정 경로를 구분한다.

B.original_option_text: Conditional viable-remediation work requires the specified risk assessment, implemented remediation, repeat sampling, and product-risk controls.
B.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 필요성만으로 자동 재개하지 않고 공간·공정·위험평가·mitigation 조건을 확인한다.

C.original_option_text: An additional remediation ceiling does not extend a shorter otherwise-applicable category or stability limit.
C.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 추가 ceiling은 최대 허용조건을 더 제한하며 기존 짧은 BUD를 늘리지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: A finding in one PEC proves every other PEC can continue without assessment.
D.original_rationale_ko:
오류를 고르는 문항의 정답. Affected·unaffected 구분과 조사 결과에 근거한 제한적 판단을 유지한다.
교정된 설명: An affected PEC and an appropriately assessed unaffected PEC can require different operational decisions.

records.original_stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacist has 18 eligible CE hours for the year: 4 live hours and 1 law hour. No exemption or specialized-practice requirement applies. Two additional hours may be completed on separate days.

Which two-hour plan completes all three outstanding requirements? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: One live pharmacy-law hour and one eligible home-study hour.
A.original_rationale_ko: Live 1시간으로 5시간, law 1시간으로 2시간, 실제 2시간으로 total 20시간을 채운다.
A.exact_authority: Policy2021-04 I;VII dualcompounding/lawcredit illustrates topic overlap; 247CMR4.03(4)(a)-(b),(5),(7)

authorities.exact_section: Policy2021-04 I;VII dualcompounding/lawcredit illustrates topic overlap

B.original_option_text: Two home-study pharmacy-law hours.
B.original_rationale_ko: Total과 law는 충족하지만 live는 4시간에 머문다.
B.exact_authority: Policy2021-04 I;VII dualcompounding/lawcredit illustrates topic overlap; 247CMR4.03(4)(a)-(b),(5),(7)

authorities.exact_section: Policy2021-04 I;VII dualcompounding/lawcredit illustrates topic overlap

C.original_option_text: Two live clinical hours with no law content.
C.original_rationale_ko: Total과 live는 충족하지만 law는 1시간에 머문다.
C.exact_authority: Policy2021-04 I;VII dualcompounding/lawcredit illustrates topic overlap; 247CMR4.03(4)(a)-(b),(5),(7)

authorities.exact_section: Policy2021-04 I;VII dualcompounding/lawcredit illustrates topic overlap

D.original_option_text: One home-study law hour, counted once as law and again toward the total.
D.original_rationale_ko: 한 시간을 두 번 세어 실제 total을 20으로 만들 수 없고 live도 부족하다.
D.exact_authority: Policy2021-04 I;VII dualcompounding/lawcredit illustrates topic overlap; 247CMR4.03(4)(a)-(b),(5),(7)

authorities.exact_section: Policy2021-04 I;VII dualcompounding/lawcredit illustrates topic overlap

records.original_stem:
A pharmacist has 13 eligible hours and finishes a 9-hour conference on a single day. Live, law, and specialized-topic requirements are satisfied.

How many conference hours may be applied under the stated daily CE limit? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: 8 conference hours.
A.original_rationale_ko: 하루 인정 상한 8시간을 적용한다. 이 사례의 인정 합계는 21시간이다.

B.original_option_text: 7 conference hours.
B.original_rationale_ko: 20시간을 맞추는 데 필요한 양과 하루 인정 가능한 상한은 다르다.

C.original_option_text: 9 conference hours.
C.original_rationale_ko: 실제 수강시간이 모두 그날의 법정 인정시간이 되는 것은 아니다.

D.original_option_text: 6 conference hours.
D.original_rationale_ko: 연간 부족분만을 하루 인정 상한으로 오인한 값이다. 최소치를 넘는 적격 교육도 구분해 기록할 수 있다.

records.original_stem:
A pharmacist graduated in 2021 and first receives a Massachusetts license by transfer on October 12, 2026. No other exemption applies.

Which statement correctly describes the posted policy's treatment of the required 2026 CE? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: The pharmacist may count the same hours again toward the full 2027 requirement.
A.original_rationale_ko: 전년도 의무 충족에 사용한 동일 시간을 다음 해의 의무에 중복 산입하지 않는다.

B.original_option_text: The pharmacist owes no 2026 CE because it is the first Massachusetts licensing year.
B.original_rationale_ko: 졸업연도 면제를 과거 졸업자의 새 MA 면허 취득연도로 옮길 수 없다.

C.original_option_text: The pharmacist must complete the 2026 hours before the transfer license can be issued.
C.original_rationale_ko: 현재 정책의 해당 연도 완료 유예와 면허 발급 전 조건을 혼동한다.

D.original_option_text: The pharmacist may complete the required 2026 hours by April 30, 2027.
D.original_rationale_ko: 10월 1일 이후 그해 첫 exam/transfer 면허 취득의 grace period이다.

records.original_stem:
An audit file contains accepted non-ACPE CE certificates and an incomplete CPE Monitor transcript. The certificates identify the participant, provider, credit type, hours, and completion dates.

Which conclusions are supported? Select ALL that apply.

A.original_option_text: The pharmacist should retain the certificates needed to establish the activity and credit earned.
A.original_rationale_ko: 수료자·프로그램·시간·수료일 등 요구 정보를 입증할 자료가 필요하다.

B.original_option_text: A certificate showing 2 CEUs necessarily proves only two contact hours.
B.original_rationale_ko: CEU와 contact hour를 동일 단위로 읽을 수 없다. 해당 인정 유형과 실제 contact hours를 확인한다.

C.original_option_text: An otherwise accepted non-ACPE activity is not rejected solely because it is absent from CPE Monitor.
C.original_rationale_ko: Monitor에 없는 적격 non-ACPE credit는 별도 증빙으로 확인한다.

D.original_option_text: An employer's education-reimbursement approval establishes Board acceptance of the activity.
D.original_rationale_ko: 회사 비용 지급과 Board가 인정하는 교육 유형은 다른 판단이다.

E.original_option_text: A completed transcript replaces any need to distinguish live from home-study credit.
E.original_rationale_ko: 총시간과 live/home-study의 인정 조건을 별도로 검토해야 한다.

records.original_stem:
A technician's Massachusetts license remains active, but national certification expired yesterday. A new Schedule IV prescription is telephoned to the pharmacy.

Who should receive this new prescription under the personnel distinctions in the notes? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Route this new Schedule IV order to a recipient whose current scope permits it.
A.original_rationale_ko: State technician 면허만 남은 사람에게 certified technician의 신규 전화처방 수신 권한을 유지시킬 수 없다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

B.original_option_text: This technician, provided the call is described as a refill in the computer.
B.original_rationale_ko: 새 처방의 실제 성격은 입력 이름을 바꾸어 달라지지 않는다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

C.original_option_text: This technician, provided the pharmacist signs the entry before dispensing.
C.original_rationale_ko: 사후 서명은 수신 당시 필요한 certification을 대신하지 않는다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

D.original_option_text: A trainee, provided the caller repeats the prescription to two employees.
D.original_rationale_ko: PTT의 전화처방 수신 제한을 직원 두 명의 청취로 해제하지 않는다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

records.original_stem:
A licensed, noncertified technician is approved to receive unchanged verbal refill authorizations. A caller instead changes a patient's directions from one tablet daily to two tablets daily.

What is the appropriate next step? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Ask the pharmacist to assess the new directions before recording authorization.
A.original_rationale_ko: Dose/directions 변경은 ordinary technician의 unchanged-refill 범위가 아니다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

B.original_option_text: Accept the change because the ingredient and tablet strength remain unchanged.
B.original_rationale_ko: 같은 제품이라도 directions가 바뀌면 unchanged prescription이라고 할 수 없다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

C.original_option_text: Accept the change after confirming that insurance will pay for the larger quantity.
C.original_rationale_ko: 보험 승인 여부는 직원의 법적 업무범위를 결정하지 않는다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

D.original_option_text: Record an unchanged refill and attach the new directions as a counseling note.
D.original_rationale_ko: 조제 지시가 바뀐 사실을 상담 메모로 옮겨 수신 권한을 우회할 수 없다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

records.original_stem:
A Massachusetts technician trainee is directly supervised. The pharmacy needs help entering a patient's address, preparing an allowed Schedule VI product, and answering a patient-specific interaction question.

Which assignments fit the trainee role? Select ALL that apply.

A.original_option_text: Resolve the interaction by reading the software's preferred recommendation to the patient.
A.original_rationale_ko: 소프트웨어 문구를 읽는 방식이라도 환자별 임상 상담·문제 해결을 대신할 수 없다.

B.original_option_text: Receive a new telephone prescription while the pharmacist listens from another workstation.
B.original_rationale_ko: PTT의 전화처방 수신 제한을 이런 배치로 없앨 수 없다.

C.original_option_text: Complete final prescription verification after a barcode match.
C.original_rationale_ko: Barcode match는 pharmacist의 final verification을 대신하지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: Enter the patient's nonclinical address information under direct supervision.
D.original_rationale_ko: 허용된 비판단적 정보 입력 업무이다.

E.original_option_text: Assist with authorized technical preparation under the required training and supervision.
E.original_rationale_ko: PTT도 허용된 기술적 준비를 도울 수 있지만 교육·감독·약사 검수 조건이 남는다.

records.original_stem:
A licensed intern under direct pharmacist supervision has entered a new prescription, completed preparation, and counseled the patient. The pharmacist has not performed final dispensing verification.

What must occur before the prescription is released? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: The intern may substitute a second barcode scan for pharmacist verification.
A.original_rationale_ko: 기술적 제품 일치 확인은 최종 약사 검수 권한을 만들지 않는다.

B.original_option_text: Another intern may independently verify the first intern's work.
B.original_rationale_ko: Intern 두 명을 조합해 약사의 최종 책임을 대체하지 않는다.

C.original_option_text: Have the pharmacist perform final dispensing verification before release.
C.original_rationale_ko: Intern의 넓은 감독하 업무범위에도 final prescription verification 제외가 남는다.

D.original_option_text: The pharmacist may postpone verification until the end-of-day reconciliation.
D.original_rationale_ko: 환자 교부 이후의 검토는 교부 전 final verification을 대신하지 않는다.

records.original_stem:
A graduate holds an active Massachusetts intern license and has just passed the required examinations. The pharmacist license is still pending. A supervising pharmacist is present.

Which assignment remains consistent with the graduate's current status? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Perform permitted intern work under the required supervision.
A.original_rationale_ko: 합격 후에도 실제 발급 전 현재 권한은 적격 intern scope이다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

B.original_option_text: Complete final dispensing verification using the supervisor's login.
B.original_rationale_ko: 공유 login은 면허·검수 권한을 대신하지 못한다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

C.original_option_text: Work as the sole pharmacist while the supervisor leaves for a meal break.
C.original_rationale_ko: Pending pharmacist license는 독립 pharmacist coverage를 허용하지 않는다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

D.original_option_text: Accept the MOR position solely on the strength of the passing report.
D.original_rationale_ko: MOR에 필요한 현재 pharmacist licensure 등을 합격 보고서로 대체하지 않는다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

records.original_stem:
NABP approves a Massachusetts reciprocity application on February 11. The pharmacist changes employers in June and uploads a missing state document in August.

Which event starts the one-year application-validity period described in 247 CMR 3.02? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: NABP's February approval.
A.original_rationale_ko: 규정의 시작점은 NABP approval이다.

B.original_option_text: The June employment change.
B.original_rationale_ko: 새 고용계약은 해당 신청의 법정 시작 사건이 아니다.

C.original_option_text: The August document upload.
C.original_rationale_ko: 보완자료 제출만으로 승인일 기준 시계가 다시 시작되지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: The first independently worked Massachusetts shift.
D.original_rationale_ko: 면허 취득을 위한 신청 유효기간을 미래 근무일에 연결할 수 없다.

records.original_stem:
A pharmacist's registration expired 20 days ago without disciplinary action. A renewal payment is pending, and no order authorizes continued practice.

Which action is appropriate for an independently staffed dispensing shift today? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Arrange coverage by a pharmacist with current authority to work this shift.
A.original_rationale_ko: 일반 만료 후 practice를 계속할 수 있는 60일 grace가 아니다.

B.original_option_text: Work the shift if the renewal receipt is displayed next to the certificate.
B.original_rationale_ko: 납부 증명은 현재 유효한 registration을 대체하지 않는다.

C.original_option_text: Work the shift as a retired pharmacist until renewal is processed.
C.original_rationale_ko: Retired status도 임시 pharmacist practice 권한이 아니다.

D.original_option_text: Work the shift because additional Board conditions begin only after 60 days.
D.original_rationale_ko: 60일 경계는 복구 조건에 관한 것이지 그 전의 업무 허가가 아니다.

records.original_stem:
An owner tracks a pharmacist registration, a Drug Store Pharmacy license, and a sterile-compounding pharmacy license. None is provisional.

Which calendar entries match the renewal distinctions in the notes? Select ALL that apply.

A.original_option_text: Odd-numbered-year December 31 for the Drug Store Pharmacy license.
A.original_rationale_ko: 일반 Drug Store의 홀수 해 주기이다.

B.original_option_text: The pharmacist's birthday for all three permissions.
B.original_rationale_ko: Technician의 생일 주기 등을 다른 개인·시설 면허에 복사하지 않는다.

C.original_option_text: Even-numbered-year December 31 for the personal pharmacist registration.
C.original_rationale_ko: 개인 pharmacist의 짝수 해 주기이다.

D.original_option_text: One facility payment renews every professional registration at that address.
D.original_rationale_ko: 여러 면허·등록은 각 요건과 갱신을 별도로 관리한다.

E.original_option_text: Annual December 31 renewal for the specified sterile-compounding license.
E.original_rationale_ko: 해당 compounding 허가는 별도 연간 갱신이다.

records.original_stem:
Two resident retail Drug Store pharmacies have nonoverlapping opening hours. One pharmacist would work 32 hours weekly at each and proposes to be MOR at both.

What prevents approval of this arrangement under the general retail MOR rule? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Concurrent MOR appointments at two retail pharmacies are prohibited.
A.original_rationale_ko: 근무시간을 각각 충족하더라도 동시 복수 MOR 제한이 남는다.

B.original_option_text: The pharmacist must average at least 40 hours at each pharmacy.
B.original_rationale_ko: 해당 기본 수치는 30시간이며, 40시간 부족이 이 사례의 문제는 아니다.

C.original_option_text: Both pharmacies must first share a real-time prescription database.
C.original_rationale_ko: Database 공유는 복수 MOR 제한의 예외 요건이 아니다.

D.original_option_text: One pharmacy must change from resident to nonresident status.
D.original_rationale_ko: 실제 장소·업무에 따른 시설 분류를 인력 편의로 임의 변경하지 않는다.

records.original_stem:
An outgoing and incoming MOR prepare an ordinary change-of-MOR inventory. The pharmacy holds oxycodone, clonazepam, pregabalin, and PMP-reportable gabapentin.

Which inventory scope is appropriate? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Include oxycodone alone because the pharmacy maintains a perpetual CII record.
A.original_rationale_ko: Routine perpetual CII 관리 범위를 change inventory 전체로 잘못 옮긴다.

B.original_option_text: Include the federally scheduled products but omit gabapentin as nonfederal.
B.original_rationale_ko: MA의 사건별 inventory에는 해당 PMP-reportable VI가 들어간다.

C.original_option_text: Count the federally scheduled stock and the PMP-reportable gabapentin.
C.original_rationale_ko: MOR change는 CII만이 아니라 II–V와 PMP-reportable VI를 포함한다.

D.original_option_text: Include oxycodone and clonazepam but omit lower schedules.
D.original_rationale_ko: Schedule V와 해당 Schedule VI를 제외할 근거가 없다.

records.original_stem:
A pharmacy submitted its relocation application 95 days before the proposed move. The Board has not approved the new location or granted an exception.

Which step is required before operating at the new site? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Wait for the first annual renewal at the new address to disclose the move.
A.original_rationale_ko: 사전 승인 의무를 사후 갱신 통지로 대체하지 않는다.

B.original_option_text: Receive the Board's approval before beginning practice at the new address.
B.original_rationale_ko: 사전 신청 기간과 실제 승인은 별도 요건이다.

C.original_option_text: Transfer the existing license by posting a copy at the new site.
C.original_rationale_ko: 허가 문서를 게시하는 행위로 새 장소의 승인을 만들 수 없다.

D.original_option_text: Move now because more than 90 days have elapsed since submission.
D.original_rationale_ko: 90일 접수 기준이 승인 간주 규정은 아니다.

records.original_stem:
A resident pharmacy changes ownership. The buyer has signed a bill of sale, and controlled stock will be transferred on the closing date.

Which matters require separate attention? Select ALL that apply.

A.original_option_text: The applicable inventory and stock-transfer documentation.
A.original_rationale_ko: 사업체 소유권, 약물 재고와 관련 attestation은 별도 절차다.

B.original_option_text: Treating the bill of sale as sufficient authorization for the buyer to dispense.
B.original_rationale_ko: 매매 증빙 자체가 유효한 면허·등록을 대신하지 않는다.

C.original_option_text: The incoming owner's required pharmacy-license application.
C.original_rationale_ko: 사업체 매매계약으로 기존 pharmacy license가 양도되지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: Resetting every patient's prescription issue date to the closing date.
D.original_rationale_ko: 소유권 변경은 처방의 발행일·유효기간을 새로 만들지 않는다.

E.original_option_text: The required advance notice for the ownership transfer.
E.original_rationale_ko: 사전 통지와 closing 계약은 다른 의무이다.

records.original_stem:
A certified technician enters a documented CII receipt and then finds an unexplained two-tablet discrepancy. The MOR is present.

Which next action respects the distinction between entry and adjustment? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Delete and reenter the receipt until the computer matches the count.
A.original_rationale_ko: 정상 거래를 지워 차이를 없애면 조사와 audit trail이 손상된다.

B.original_option_text: Offset the difference against tomorrow's anticipated dispensing.
B.original_rationale_ko: 미래 거래를 이용해 현재 차이를 숨기는 방식은 적절한 reconciliation이 아니다.

C.original_option_text: Refer the discrepancy to the MOR for investigation and adjustment.
C.original_rationale_ko: CPhT data entry 권한을 unexplained balance adjustment로 확대하지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: Reduce the balance by two under the receipt-entry authority.
D.original_rationale_ko: 문서화된 입고 입력과 원인 미상의 잔량 조정은 다른 행위다.

records.original_stem:
A pharmacist earned a PharmD in 2021 and first seeks a CDTM agreement in 2026. The pharmacist has not established five years of qualifying practice or a Board-recognized education/residency equivalency.

Which statement best addresses the experience requirement? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: An employer's agreement to supervise substitutes for Board-recognized equivalency.
A.original_rationale_ko: 기관 supervision 제안만으로 Board equivalency 요건을 새로 만들지 않는다.

B.original_option_text: Document a recognized experience or equivalency route beyond the PharmD alone.
B.original_rationale_ko: 2017-06-30까지 CPA에 들어간 PharmD 경로와 현재의 첫 CPA를 구분한다.

C.original_option_text: A liability-insurance certificate establishes the experience equivalency.
C.original_rationale_ko: 보험과 경력·교육 동등성은 별도 자격이다.

D.original_option_text: The PharmD automatically substitutes for five years for any newly signed agreement.
D.original_rationale_ko: 과거 날짜 조건을 모든 현재 PharmD에게 확대할 수 없다.

records.original_stem:
A pharmacist practices CDTM throughout the year and has completed the usual 20-hour general CE requirement. The record contains no additional CDTM-related education.

What education remains under the stated CDTM CE structure? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Five additional approved hours related to the CDTM practice area.
A.original_rationale_ko: CDTM는 일반 20에 추가 5시간이므로 총 25시간 구조를 확인한다.

B.original_option_text: Five hours selected from the same 20 already used to meet the general minimum.
B.original_rationale_ko: 추가 시간 요건을 기존 20시간의 재분류만으로 충족시키지 않는다.

C.original_option_text: No additional hours until the two-year agreement renewal.
C.original_rationale_ko: CPA review 주기와 매 calendar year의 CE는 별도 시계이다.

D.original_option_text: Five additional hours for every prescription changed under the agreement.
D.original_rationale_ko: 추가 CE를 개별 처방 변경 수에 곱하는 규칙이 아니다.

records.original_stem:
A fully licensed technician has worked 520 hours after full licensure, has current CPR, and has completed the required six-hour vaccine course. National certification is not held. The documented on-the-job skills training has not yet occurred.

Which remaining requirement is identified by these facts? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Repeating 500 hours as a trainee before using the completed full-license hours.
A.original_rationale_ko: Full licensure 이후 근무경험을 trainee 기간으로 대체하거나 되돌릴 필요가 있다는 규칙이 아니다.

B.original_option_text: Obtaining national certification because experience cannot be used instead.
B.original_rationale_ko: Policy의 certification 또는 full-license 이후 500시간 경로를 구분한다.

C.original_option_text: Completing a PharmD before any supervised vaccine administration.
C.original_rationale_ko: 적격 technician 경로의 요건을 pharmacist 학위 요건으로 바꾸지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: The additional documented on-the-job training and skills checklist.
D.original_rationale_ko: Full-license 이후 500시간 경로를 갖췄어도 추가 실무교육 요건이 남는다.

records.original_stem:
An internship timesheet lists 13 hours in one day. This question concerns the maximum internship credit for that day, not whether every aspect of the work schedule complied with other rules.

How many hours can receive internship credit under the stated daily cap? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: 8 hours.
A.original_rationale_ko: CE 하루 인정 상한과 internship credit 한도는 다르다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

B.original_option_text: 10 hours.
B.original_rationale_ko: 이 사례에 적용되는 intern credit 상한은 10시간이 아니다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

C.original_option_text: 12 hours.
C.original_rationale_ko: 247 CMR 8.01의 하루 internship credit 상한은 12시간이다. 근무의 적법성 전부를 판정하는 문항은 아니다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

D.original_option_text: 13 hours.
D.original_rationale_ko: 기록상 근무시간을 그대로 인정하면 하루 credit 상한을 초과한다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

records.original_stem:
A pharmacy outside Massachusetts wants to ship prescription medications to Massachusetts patients. Its home-state permit is valid, but it has not completed the applicable Massachusetts licensing process.

Which conclusion is correct? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Massachusetts authorization is needed only after the first patient complaint.
A.original_rationale_ko: 허가 시점을 민원 발생 뒤로 미룰 수 없다.

B.original_option_text: Establish the required Massachusetts authorization before these shipments.
B.original_rationale_ko: MA로 dispense/ship하는 해당 약국의 MA 허가요건을 별도로 충족해야 한다.

C.original_option_text: The home-state permit substitutes for Massachusetts authorization for mail delivery.
C.original_rationale_ko: 우편이라는 전달방식이 nonresident 요건을 없애지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: A Massachusetts patient's consent substitutes for the nonresident license.
D.original_rationale_ko: 환자 동의와 시설의 법적 자격은 다른 조건이다.

records.original_stem:
A pharmacy asks the Board to waive a facility requirement. The request remains pending, and no emergency authorization has been issued.

Which action is appropriate while the request is considered? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Treat the owner's professional license as interim waiver authority.
A.original_rationale_ko: 소유자 개인 면허는 Board의 waiver 결정 권한을 대신하지 않는다.

B.original_option_text: Apply the requested waiver to related federal requirements as well.
B.original_rationale_ko: Board 권한 밖의 상위·연방 요건까지 포괄적으로 면제할 수 없다.

C.original_option_text: Implement the proposed alternative on the date the request is submitted.
C.original_rationale_ko: 신청 접수와 승인을 동일한 사건으로 취급한 것이다.

D.original_option_text: Follow the existing requirement until the applicable waiver is granted.
D.original_rationale_ko: Waiver 신청만으로 의무가 정지되지 않는다.

records.original_stem:
A hiring file contains a national technician certificate, a state professional license, and a facility DEA registration.

Which distinctions must be preserved? Select ALL that apply.

A.original_option_text: A valid DEA registration does not expand a person's professional scope.
A.original_rationale_ko: 등록한 약물·활동이라도 직종의 허용 범위를 지켜야 한다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

B.original_option_text: Facility registration and an individual professional license identify different permissions.
B.original_rationale_ko: 사람과 장소·활동의 허가를 구분한다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

C.original_option_text: One current certificate may replace the other credentials if the employer accepts it.
C.original_rationale_ko: 고용주의 수용이 법적으로 별개인 자격을 합치지 않는다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

D.original_option_text: A DEA-number check digit establishes current licensure and every authorized schedule.
D.original_rationale_ko: 번호 형식 검증은 실제 유효성·범위·신원을 모두 입증하지 않는다.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

E.original_option_text: National certification does not by itself issue a Massachusetts technician license.

authorities.version_or_publication_date: 247CMR8 MassRegister1546 publication2025-04-25 mixed1/9/25 and4/6/18 pageeffective dates

records.original_stem:
A Massachusetts methylphenidate prescription was issued 34 days ago. It authorizes a 90-day supply, has never been filled, and is presented for routine outpatient dispensing today.

Which fact prevents dispensing under this prescription? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: A 90-day supply of a non-opioid CII is categorically prohibited.
A.original_rationale_ko: 현행 §23(d)의 non-opioid CII/CIII 범주를 놓친 결론이다.

B.original_option_text: The prescription has passed the Massachusetts 30-day validity period.
B.original_rationale_ko: 90-day supply가 허용되는 분류라도 30-day prescription validity가 늘어나지 않는다.

C.original_option_text: Methylphenidate prescriptions are limited to a seven-day supply in every adult.
C.original_rationale_ko: 일반 first-opioid 7일 제한 등을 non-opioid CII 전체에 적용한 오답이다.

D.original_option_text: A previously unfilled CII prescription needs a refill authorization.
D.original_rationale_ko: 최초 조제와 refill은 다르며 CII는 refill을 할 수 없다.

records.original_stem:
A practitioner issues several Schedule II prescriptions during one visit and wants the second prescription used later.

How should the issuance date and delayed-use instruction be represented under the federal multiple-prescription framework? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Use the intended pickup date as the issuance date on the second prescription.
A.original_rationale_ko: 미래의 issue date를 붙이는 것과 earliest-fill instruction은 다르다.

B.original_option_text: Use the previous prescription's last-fill date as the new issuance date.
B.original_rationale_ko: 실제 새로운 발행 사건과 과거 조제일을 혼동한다.

C.original_option_text: Use the actual issuance date and a separate earliest-fill instruction.
C.original_rationale_ko: 실제 발행일은 유지하고 조제 가능 시작일을 별도로 표시한다.

D.original_option_text: Leave the issuance date blank for the pharmacist to complete at pickup.
D.original_rationale_ko: 처방자는 발행 시 요구되는 날짜를 갖춰야 한다.

records.original_stem:
A pharmacy dispenses 12 tablets from a valid prescription for 30 oxycodone tablets solely because of stock shortage. No patient- or prescriber-requested partial-fill pathway was established. More than 72 hours after that partial fill, the rest becomes available.

What is required before supplying additional tablets under these facts? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Reclassify the original shortage as a patient request without further documentation.
A.original_rationale_ko: 실제 요청과 기록 없이 편한 기한으로 사후 변경할 수 없다.

B.original_option_text: Notify the prescriber and obtain a new prescription for further supply.
B.original_rationale_ko: Shortage 경로의 잔량 기한을 넘겼으므로 통지하고 새로운 적법한 처방이 필요하다.

C.original_option_text: Transfer the remaining 18 tablets as an unused initial EPCS prescription.
C.original_rationale_ko: 이미 일부 조제했으므로 initial unfilled EPCS가 아니다.

D.original_option_text: Dispense the remainder because the prescription is less than 30 days old.
D.original_rationale_ko: 일반 validity가 shortage-specific 잔량 기한을 연장하지 않는다.
